device_name: QUARTEX ADDITION-C Complex and Revision Cervico-Thoracic fusion

specs.Screw Type: Occipital , Posterior Cervical (Lateral Mass) , Pedicle Screws (Cervico-Thoracic)

description: The Globus Medical QUARTEX ADDITION-C is an addition set to be used with either complex or revision cervico-thoracic fusions requiring connection to either existing fusion or primary implant requiring complex rod connection. This set offers a variety of hardware to connect to various rod diameters and arrangements. Intended for use with the QUARTEX OCT set
